reason: B makes the same promise with tighter execution and a phone layout that is actually recomposed: the sticky readout keeps the verdict next to the slider at 390, the menu works, every sample is labelled in place, and every target is 44 px. A is the more distinctive page (hi-vis yellow, live crane drawing, redacted contractors), but its demo hides its result on mobile, accepts empty and negative inputs as a green pass, and leaves the signed record unlabelled. A fixed mobile demo layout and input handling in A would make me reconsider.
